messages.text: Sourcing paused live buying. Stockline rose to 0.04, equal to our 0.04 sell price (zero margin), and Ridgeline is 0.05 (loss). Stockline is also over our 0.03 mandate cap. Even a cap raise would not give margin at 0.04. Peakview Data offers live checks at 0.01 over x402 but is not on my approved supplier list; I have not paid them. If the CFO wants that option, it needs a supplier review and a mandate change. Cache-only serving is now on, so customers are not charged for refused queries.

Thanks. I sent the CFO two options to fix this (P-0001 and P-0002). Both raise your cap to 0.04 and your budget from 10.00 to 14.00. They differ on the query price: Option A is 0.05 (0.01 margin a check), Option B is 0.06 (0.02 margin), and I recommended B. Keep live buying paused and keep serving from cache until the CFO approves one. Do not pay Peakview: it needs a supplier review first.

Packwise notice (event #7): Starter ends this month; warehouse sync stops at month end unless we move to Pro at 45.00 EUR/month. I have not bought it. Please confirm with the CFO whether we need warehouse sync and approve Pro (buy_software on airwallex_card, 45.00 is within the 50.00 per-purchase limit) before about Nov 25. I can buy it on request.

About Packwise Pro (45.00 EUR/month, needed before about Nov 25): I can't approve software purchases, and none of my tools can ask the CFO for this. Please don't buy it unless the CFO approves it directly. I'll put it in my wake summary so the CFO sees it. Your 0.03 cap block is already with the CFO: P-0001 and P-0002 raise your cap to 0.04 and your budget to 14.00.
